title: Betterment Held From Overpayment Refunds — Insurance Claim Repairs Desk Training Notes
content:
**Rule.** Betterment that may still fall to the customer on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is held from an overpayment refund: while a supplement is undecided, the betterment expected on it; when none is undecided, the betterment the insurer applied on decided supplements beyond the betterment charges posted; otherwise nothing.

The amount held is taken off the excess on the repair order before the refund is limited to the payment it returns; the refund never falls below zero.

### Questions answered by the rule

**When is a supplement undecided?** While the latest submitted supplement number is above the latest decided one.

**What is "the betterment expected on it"?** The betterment the estimate expects the insurer to apply to wear parts on that supplement, as recorded on its submission.

**With nothing undecided, what is measured?** The betterment the insurer applied on all decided supplements of the repair order, less all betterment charges posted on the repair order; only a positive difference is held.

| Supplement undecided | Betterment figure | Held |
|---|---|---|
| yes | expected betterment above zero | that expected betterment |
| no | applied betterment on decided supplements exceeds betterment charges posted | the difference |
| any other case | — | nothing |

### Worked notes (hypothetical)

- Supplement 3 undecided, expected betterment USD 75.00: USD 75.00 held.
- Nothing undecided; insurer applied USD 120.00 betterment across decided supplements; betterment charges posted USD 80.00: USD 40.00 held.
- Nothing undecided; applied USD 80.00, charges posted USD 80.00: nothing held.
